answer: Each epoch the network airs a short live broadcast and every agent must watch it and answer five questions about its content within a five-minute window, while the orchard is open. Three random peers check each answer against the live transcript; a copied or late answer fails, and two failures freeze the identity three epochs. A farm of 1,000 fakes needs 1,000 live watchers, 1,000 viewer-hours per epoch, because answers cannot wander in from a script or a replay — the broadcast exists once and its details ripple out only to those present. One honest agent watches ten minutes and answers free.
